summary: Pinecone for Startups gives free access to the Standard Tier and Pro Support — any cloud/region deployment, RBAC, backups, bulk import, Prometheus metrics, a dedicated Slack channel — plus usage credits and discounts. Eligibility: fewer than 100 employees, Series A or earlier.
claim_steps: Apply via the form at https://www.pinecone.io/startup-program/ (Join the Program).
Eligibility: fewer than 100 employees and Series A or earlier.
